label: Global Renewable Capacity
deltaNote: Added in 2025 — a new single-year record (15.5% growth); renewables now ~49% of global power capacity

label: Global EV New-Car Sales Share
deltaNote: IEA confirmed 20.2M EVs sold in 2025 — 1 in 4 new cars globally. China: ~55% EV share; Europe: 28%; US: ~10%. Global EV fleet now displaces 1.2 Mb/d of oil. 2026 forecast: 23M EVs (28% share).

label: Global Clean Energy Investment
deltaNote: Record $2.3 T in 2025 — first time exceeding $2.3 T; over 2x fossil fuel spending

label: Countries with Net-Zero Targets
contestNote: Many targets lack credible implementation plans or legislation

label: India Non-Fossil Installed Power Capacity
deltaNote: Surpassed 50% NDC target in May 2026, five years ahead of 2030 Paris Agreement commitment. 254+ GW non-fossil capacity; 55.3 GW added in FY 2025-26 (record single-year addition).

label: CO₂ Captured Annually (CCS + DAC)
source: IEA CCS Report 2023 / Global CCS Institute
deltaNote: Still <1% of what's needed by 2050 under net-zero scenarios

label: Amazon Deforestation Rate
deltaNote: Rolling 12-month DETER alert total is the lowest since 2013 and 55.6% below the preceding 10-year average, coinciding with stronger enforcement and Indigenous-territory protection under the Lula administration. If confirmed by the higher-resolution PRODES system, Brazil could record its lowest official Amazon deforestation rate since satellite monitoring began in 1988. The Amazon remains vulnerable to logging, drought, degradation and fire, which don't always register as clear deforestation.

label: Global Battery Storage Deployed (2025)
deltaNote: Energy storage entered the '100 GW era' in 2025. Solar-to-storage ratio fell from 56:1 (2016) to 6:1 (2025). BNEF projects 158 GW / 459 GWh installed in 2026 and 2.9 TW cumulative by 2036.

label: New Wind Capacity Added (2025)
deltaNote: 2025 smashed the 2024 record of 117 GW; wind + solar = 96.8% of all new renewable additions

label: Renewables Share of Global Electricity (2025)
deltaNote: Full-year 2025 average; overtook coal globally for first time since 1919. April 2026 milestone: wind+solar alone hit 22% of global electricity vs 20% for gas — the first month ever that combined wind+solar exceeded gas worldwide (Ember, May 22, 2026; 531 TWh vs 477 TWh). June 2026: solar alone became the EU's single largest power source at 25% share (52 TWh) — the first month any single non-fossil source has led EU generation (Ember, Jul 14, 2026).

label: Global Monthly EV Sales Record
deltaNote: First calendar month ever above 2 million EVs sold globally. H1 2026 YTD: 9.6M, +27% YTD. Europe set an all-time monthly record (+31% YoY); North America fell year-to-date after the US federal EV tax credit expired in Sept 2025.

label: Germany Installed Solar Capacity
deltaNote: Germany passed its statutory 2026 solar expansion target ahead of schedule; over 6 million PV installations now operating. Next milestones: 172 GWp by 2028, 215 GWp by 2030 — requiring ~20 GWp/yr versus ~17.5 GWp installed in each of the last two years.

label: US Renewables Share of Utility-Scale Capacity
source: EIA Electric Power Monthly (data through Jun 30, 2026; released Aug 25-28, 2026)
delta: On pace to overtake natural gas by summer 2027
deltaNote: Nearly double the 16.9% share a decade earlier. EIA projects ~82.9 GW of new wind, solar and battery storage capacity added vs. a ~3.1 GW decline in combined fossil-fuel and nuclear capacity through June 2027, pushing renewables' share to a projected 37.1%.

label: BYD Monthly BEV Sales Record
deltaNote: First month BYD has sold over 250,000 battery-electric vehicles. Overseas NEV sales hit a record 189,466 units (+134% YoY, 43% of total volume), offsetting a 14.3% YoY decline in domestic China sales.
